title: Quadtrees — Why Waste Detail on Empty Space?
description:
A quadtree asks one question, recursively: does this square hold too many points? Split it into four and ask again. Dense clusters get subdivided down to tiny cells — empty space stays one big square. This is how game engines skip most collision checks entirely.
